subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my note about driving validated-lead volume for your listing-to-contact flows. The one point worth repeating: we optimize to the validated lead and read it back through your acceptance signal, a server-to-server postback via your MMP, so duplicate, aged, and bot enquiries are screened out before billing. At scale we hold a post-validation acceptance rate near 71 percent (illustrative). If it helps, I can share the category-level lead-acceptance view. Worth a short look?
angle: warm bump, restate validated-lead acceptance-read proof
illustrative_flags: post-validation acceptance rate near 71 percent (MobUpps, illustrative)
register_notes: Stage 1 EN classifieds: references prior outreach in first sentence; restates single proof from parent (validated-lead optimization + S2S acceptance postback via MMP + duplicate/aged/bot screening before billing); one illustrative MobUpps figure (71% post-validation acceptance rate), flagged; soft CTA, exactly 1 question mark; no sign-off; native UK English; no em-dash, no 'X, not Y'.
